notes: Dhaka Stock Exchange listed companies — the cleanest OPEN Bangladeshi company source. company_listing.php lists ~640 instruments (verified: 637 trading-code + name pairs parsed, e.g. AAMRANET / aamra networks limited, ACMELAB / The ACME Laboratories Limited). Each company has a browser-public detail page displayCompany.php?name=<CODE> with Trading Code, Scrip Code, Sector, Authorized Capital (mn), Paid-up Capital (mn), Listing Year, Market Category, Type of Instrument. Plain parseable HTML (not a SPA); no auth/payment. Listed companies only. Key = DSE trading code. Currency BDT.

source_name: RJSC — Registrar of Joint Stock Companies and Firms
organization: Registrar of Joint Stock Companies and Firms (RJSC), Ministry of Commerce (roc.gov.bd)
notes: The authoritative Bangladeshi company registrar (Registrar of Joint Stock Companies and Firms) — registers companies, partnership firms, societies, and trade organizations. The main site roc.gov.bd had a TLS intermediate-certificate issue (reachable with -k; home 301-redirects) and the eservices portal (eservices.roc.gov.bd did NOT resolve) hosts company name search (free) and document/schedule retrieval which is PAY-PER-USE. No open bulk or free API. Key = RJSC registration number. Directors are personal data. Field model from public knowledge; nothing captured.

The second Bangladeshi exchange. Reachable (HTTP 200). Lists companies/securities (largely overlapping with DSE). Browser-public; not separately parsed in this pass. Use DSE as the primary listed source; CSE as a cross-check.

source_name: National Board of Revenue (NBR) — taxpayer / BIN verification
notes: The National Board of Revenue. Reachable (HTTP 200). Provides BIN (Business Identification Number) and e-TIN verification; VAT registration is via the separate VAT online system. Per-BIN/TIN verification, not a bulk download. Identifier = BIN / e-TIN. Complements RJSC/DSE with tax identity.

National open-data portal (DKAN). Reachable; datasets are statistical/sectoral (schools, rice trade, doctor directory, birth registration, poverty surveys) — NOT a company register. The DKAN API path (/api/3/action/...) 301-redirected. No company-register dataset found. Listed for completeness.
